title: Make Engram fence release ordering callback-safe
outcome: After a successful deferred authority rotation, the code clears per-runtime stop fences before releasing the project reset fence. A terminal callback can land in that gap, fail binding/checkpoint access behind the project fence, then complete the turn while leaving its Engram grant open. Release the project fence while runtime callbacks remain fenced, then clear/take and replay deferred callbacks under exact token+generation ownership.
acceptance: Both settings branches release the project reset fence before runtime-stop callback replay; no callback can observe both an absent runtime-stop owner and an owned project fence; a deterministic gated regression covers the post-revoke/pre-project-release interleaving.
